title: Review
description: A native (in-app) review of a place (T-059) — the shape of ReviewResource. Served inside place detail under ?include=reviews, listed by GET /places/{place}/reviews, and returned on its own by POST/PUT /places/{place}/reviews. `author` is null when the reviewer is not a public profile: the identity is withheld, never anonymized into a stub.

author.description: The reviewer, or null when their profile is not public.

is_own.description: Whether THIS viewer wrote the review — drives the edit affordance. False for guests.
